fusions.name: Stampede Front
fusions.desc: A thundering cone that deals 16 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Cadence Strike
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Cavalry Call
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Drumming Pace
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
